description: UNAVAILABLE: Reads QTL colocalisation from L2G feature values rather than from the colocalisation tables, so CLPP thresholds apply to model features. A colocalisation statistic plugin and a derived replacement arrive in phase 3.; use genetics.query_colocalisation, genetics.get_colocalisation_by_chromosome. Get QTL colocalization evidence from L2G features.

gene_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

study_locus_id.description: Accepts study_locus_id; resolved to one study_locus_id (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
